newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's TIIE 28-day rate falls to 21.39 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's TIIE 28-day rate falls to 21.39 pct.

text.p: Mexico's 28-day interbank interest rate (TIIE) fell 19 basis points to 21.3900 percent on Tuesday from 21.5800 percent on Monday, Banco de Mexico said.
The TIIP fell 5.66 basis points to 21.3441 percent on Tuesday from 21.4007 percent the week before.
The 91-day TIIE rose 3.50 basis points to 22.7850 percent on Tuesday from 22.7500 percent the week before.
The TIIE is a market-weighted average interbank rate that is replacing the TIIP, an average interbank rate.
